idea-plugin.name: Automatic XMake2CMake
idea-plugin.description:
Generates CMakeLists.txt in the directory of a modified xmake.lua, for any location inside the project.

The plugin cooperates with the XMake plugin and uses the xmake path configured there by default; another xmake executable and additional argumegonts are configurable. The XMake plugin is not required: without it the xmake executable is resolved from the PATH.

Generation is triggered by saving a modified xmake.lua, by closing its editor tab, or, for an unchanged xmake.lua, by invoking Force Update CMakeLists.txt (context menu, or the default Ctrl+S shortcut, rebindable in Settings | Keymap); that last case requests confirmation first.

The project description is validated with xmake f -y before generation. Settings | Tools | Automatic XMake2CMake provides three modes: confirmation before each generation, generation without confirmation, and disabled.

External modifications made while the project or the file is closed are not detected.

在项目内任意位置，xmake.lua 被修改后，自动在其所在目录生成 CMakeLists.txt。

本插件与 XMake 插件协作，默认使用其中配置的 xmake 路径；可配置其它 xmake 可执行文件与附加参数。XMake 插件并非必需：未安装时从系统 PATH 解析 xmake。

触发方式：保存已修改的 xmake.lua；关闭其编辑器标签页；对未修改的 xmake.lua 调用 Force Update CMakeLists.txt（右键菜单，或默认快捷键 Ctrl+S，可在 Settings | Keymap 中修改），该方式先请求确认。

生成前使用 xmake f -y 校验工程描述。Settings | Tools | Automatic XMake2CMake 提供三种模式：每次生成前确认、无需确认、不自动生成。

项目关闭期间或文件关闭后发生的外部修改不会被检测。

action.description: Regenerate CMakeLists.txt from xmake.lua even when xmake.lua has not changed.
